CustomField.description: Tenant label as it appears in Yardi. Text, not a lookup: no Tenant object exists in this org, and ARCHITECTURE.md reserves the bare object name for a relationship field. This is the grouping column for the FSD 5.9.9 exposure rankings until Account__c is populated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tenant name exactly as Yardi spells it. Two tenants with the same name at different properties will group together on the exposure ranking.
CustomField.label: Tenant Name
